events.label: US/Israel strike Iran
events.description: Surprise 12-hour campaign: ~900 strikes across 26 provinces. Khamenei and 7+ senior officials killed. Nuclear facilities at Natanz and Fordow hit.

events.label: Iran retaliates
events.description: Iran launches 500+ ballistic/naval missiles and ~2,000 drones. 40% aimed at Israel, 60% at US regional targets. Bahrain, Kuwait, Oman struck.

events.label: Hezbollah enters war
events.description: Hezbollah resumes rocket and drone attacks on Israel within 48 hours of the initial strike.

events.label: Strait of Hormuz closed
events.description: Iran closes the Strait of Hormuz to foreign shipping. All major carriers suspend transits. Insurance cancelled from March 5.

events.label: Oil production drops 10M+ bpd
events.description: Kuwait, Iraq, Saudi Arabia, and UAE production collectively drops by 10+ million barrels per day.

events.label: UNSC Resolution 2817
events.description: Security Council adopts resolution condemning Iran's attacks on neighbors. 13-0-2 (Russia and China abstain).

events.label: Ceasefire talks deadlocked
events.description: Iran rejects US 15-point ceasefire proposal as 'maximalist.' Issues counterproposal demanding reparations and sovereignty over Hormuz.

events.label: Houthis enter war
events.description: Houthis launch ballistic missiles at Israel and declare entry into the war, demanding strikes on Iran and Hezbollah stop.
